source.geometryMethod: deterministic local alpha-card and silhouette-specific closed-proxy generator
source.textureMethod: two ImageGen transparent foliage sources conditioned into one shared PBR atlas

imageGenSources.promptSummary: Transparent photoreal temperate shrub branch cluster under flat overcast light, with small oval leaves, visible twigs and natural gaps; no pot, ground, flowers, cartoon or low-poly styling.
Transparent photoreal continuous rectangular clipped temperate hedge panel under flat overcast light, with dense small leaves and twigs; no separate bushes, pot or ground.

material.name: temperate-shrub-v1-pbr
material.edgeTreatment: semi-transparent texels decontaminated toward olive; alpha at or below 22 removed before mip delivery

deliveryAggregateMethod: sha256 of the concatenated lowercase SHA256 hex digests of all 8 GLBs sorted by absolute path

reviews.note: Live Electron/WebGPU roadside proof after aligning the hedge local +X long axis with the road tangent.
Live WebGPU overhead proof that the 48-triangle bush caster resolves as three compact overlapping foliage masses attached to each plant, without the rejected broad octagon or pill silhouette.

rejections.reason: The shared branch image read as pale horizontal ribbons from oblique views. Production bush geometry uses only irregular upright and leaning crossed cards.
Repeated panels read as separate shrubs and exposed vertical seams. Production geometry uses a dedicated continuous side panel plus separate top/end atlas crop.
Semi-transparent source-edge colors produced bright mip halos. Production atlas decontaminates edge RGB toward foliage olive and removes very low alpha before WebP encoding.
Partial-alpha texels still produced bright strokes in the live WebGPU scene. Production uses a strict 0.85 alpha mask without alpha-to-coverage.

rejections.delivery: generic local-Z street yaw applied to the hedge
rejections.reason: The imported hedge's long axis is local +X, so the generic street transform exposed its narrow end and made it read as a post. Production placement applies a hedge-only quarter turn while preserving positions, stable keys, counts and save fingerprints.

rejections.delivery: single broad bush ellipsoid and first two-lobe replacement
rejections.reason: The broad proxy projected as an unrelated regular octagon, while two touching lobes still formed a long pill. The accepted 48-triangle delivery uses three compact, lightly overlapping closed masses that follow the irregular crown footprint.
